hooks.name: Pre-commit: lint + tests
hooks.description: Before any git commit, run lint and tests; block the commit (exit 2) if they fail.

action.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); if printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -q "git commit"; then echo "[pre-commit hook] running lint + tests..." >&2; cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0; if npm run lint >/tmp/ss_lint.log 2>&1 && npm test >/tmp/ss_test.log 2>&1; then echo "[pre-commit hook] lint + tests passed" >&2; exit 0; else echo "[pre-commit hook] BLOCKED: lint or tests failed. See /tmp/ss_lint.log and /tmp/ss_test.log" >&2; tail -20 /tmp/ss_lint.log /tmp/ss_test.log >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0
